entries.test: Public reporting from 2025 would establish the prominence of circular AI financing and whether Nvidia's reported $100 billion OpenAI investment contemplated substantial purchases of Nvidia chips.
entries.note: “Supposedly” qualifies the reported investment plan; he does not claim the investment was completed.

entries.test: Public announcements and financial reporting would establish whether the circular AI financing arrangements described underwent a broad collapse or were durably executed and sustained.
entries.note: “Poised to collapse” asserts an impending outcome rather than merely raising a possibility. The reference to 2026 supplies context without an explicit deadline.
